metadata.question: Around the Lake Eerie and upstate New York, was there more snow on March 1, 2020 in comparison to the same region on February 22, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily snow cover (Terra MOD10A1 and Aqua MYD10A1) over a bounding box covering Lake Erie and upstate New York. Query each target date; if empty, merge Terra+Aqua within a ±1-day window as fallback.
2. Masking strategy: Keep valid NDSI_Snow_Cover values (0–100). Exclude permanent water using JRC Global Surface Water (occurrence > 50). Invalid (>=200) or missing are treated as clouds/invalid. Report cloud% as fraction of land pixels lacking valid snow values.
3. Logic: If no images after fallback -> C1. If images exist but validCount=0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside [0,100] -> C3. Otherwise compare mean snow% between dates for answer A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const region = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [-84.5, 40.9],
      [-84.5, 45.7],
      [-72.5, 45.7],
      [-72.5, 40.9],
      [-84.5, 40.9]
    ]);
    const scale = 1000;
    const dates = ['2020-02-22', '2020-03-01'];

    // Land (exclude permanent water like Lake Erie)
    const waterOcc = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater').select('occurrence');
    const waterMask = waterOcc.gt(50);
    const landMask = waterMask.not();

    const landCountImg = ee.Image(1).updateMask(landMask).rename('ones');
    const landCountDict = landCountImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const landCount = ee.Number(landCountDict.get('ones'));

    function getComposite(dateStr) {
      const d0 = ee.Date(dateStr);
      const d1 = d0.advance(1, 'day');

      const t0 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterDate(d0, d1).filterBounds(region);
      const a0 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD10A1').filterDate(d0, d1).filterBounds(region);
      const merged0 = t0.merge(a0).sort('system:time_start');
      const size0 = merged0.size();

      const fbStart = d0.advance(-1, 'day');
      const fbEnd = d0.advance(2, 'day'); // +/- 1 day window
      const tFb = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterDate(fbStart, fbEnd).filterBounds(region);
      const aFb = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD10A1').filterDate(fbStart, fbEnd).filterBounds(region);
      const mergedFb = tFb.merge(aFb).sort('system:time_start');
      const sizeFb = mergedFb.size();

      const useFb = size0.eq(0);
      const usedCol = ee.ImageCollection(ee.Algorithms.If(useFb, mergedFb, merged0));
      const mosaic = usedCol.mosaic().select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').rename('snow');

      return ee.Dictionary({
        date: dateStr,
        tCount0: t0.size(),
        aCount0: a0.size(),
        tCountFb: tFb.size(),
        aCountFb: aFb.size(),
        usedFallback: useFb,
        colSizeUsed: ee.Number(ee.Algorithms.If(useFb, sizeFb, size0)),
        image: mosaic
      });
    }

    function computeStats(dict) {
      const img = ee.Image(dict.get('image'));
      const valid = img.gte(0).and(img.lte(100)).and(landMask);
      const validImg = img.updateMask(valid);

      const validCount = ee.Number(validImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('snow'));

      const meanSnowPct = ee.Number(validImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('snow'));

      const cloudPct = ee.Number(1).subtract(validCount.divide(landCount)).multiply(100);

      return dict.combine(ee.Dictionary({
        landCount: landCount,
        validCount: validCount,
        cloudPct: cloudPct,
        meanSnowPct: meanSnowPct
      }), true);
    }

    function eeToPromise(obj) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        obj.evaluate((res, err) => {
          if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res);
        });
      });
    }

    // Build and compute stats for both dates
    const d1Dict = computeStats(getComposite(dates[0]));
    const d2Dict = computeStats(getComposite(dates[1]));

    const o1 = await eeToPromise(d1Dict);
    const o2 = await eeToPromise(d2Dict);

    // Helper to print concise line
    function fmtLine(o) {
      const usedFb = !!o.usedFallback;
      const landPx = o.landCount || 0;
      const validPx = o.validCount || 0;
      const cloud = (o.cloudPct !== null && o.cloudPct !== undefined) ? Number(o.cloudPct).toFixed(1) : 'NA';
      const meanSnow = (o.meanSnowPct !== null && o.meanSnowPct !== undefined) ? Number(o.meanSnowPct).toFixed(1) : 'NA';
      return `${o.date} T:${o.tCount0} A:${o.aCount0} UsedFB:${usedFb} LandPx:${landPx} ValidPx:${validPx} Cloud%:${cloud} MeanSnow%:${meanSnow}`;
    }

    // Case handling: C1 if collection empty even after fallback
    if ((o1.colSizeUsed === 0) || (o2.colSizeUsed === 0)) {
      console.log(fmtLine(o1));
      console.log(fmtLine(o2));
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Case handling: C2 if no valid pixels after masking
    if ((o1.validCount === 0) || (o2.validCount === 0)) {
      console.log(fmtLine(o1));
      console.log(fmtLine(o2));
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Case handling: C3 if invalid stats
    const m1 = o1.meanSnowPct;
    const m2 = o2.meanSnowPct;
    if (
      m1 === null || m2 === null ||
      m1 === undefined || m2 === undefined ||
      !isFinite(Number(m1)) || !isFinite(Number(m2)) ||
      Number(m1) < 0 || Number(m1) > 100 ||
      Number(m2) < 0 || Number(m2) > 100
    ) {
      console.log(fmtLine(o1));
      console.log(fmtLine(o2));
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(fmtLine(o1));
    console.log(fmtLine(o2));
    const delta = Number(m2) - Number(m1);
    console.log(`Delta MeanSnow% (2020-03-01 minus 2020-02-22): ${delta.toFixed(2)}`);

    // Final decision
    if (Number(m2) > Number(m1)) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
